name: walk

White spiky hair, cyan eyes, warm tan skin, dark SHORT-SLEEVE shirt covering torso under OPEN sleeveless hooded vest, thin cyan/magenta neon piping, burgundy pockets, dark cargo pants/boots, silver LEFT forearm armor. Full figures contained inside each cell with generous transparent gutters, no clipping or overlap. Head-to-boot standing height should be about 165 logical pixels; preserve body scale when bending. Consistent ground baseline and centered hip/root across cells, animate IN PLACE, no travel across sheet. Eight clearly DISTINCT sequential poses, not duplicate static art. WALK seamless complete cycle: 1 right leg forward heel contact/left back, 2 right foot weight acceptance, 3 left leg passing under hips/right support, 4 left leg extends forward, 5 LEFT leg forward heel contact/right back, 6 left weight acceptance, 7 RIGHT leg passing under hips/left support, 8 right leg extends forward to transition into frame1. Arms swing in opposition to legs. Upright relaxed torso, small vertical bob, both halves of the stride equally represented.
